---
name: "nf-core/vcf_filter_survivor_bcftools"
description: "Filter a VCF file of structural variants with SURVIVOR and/or bcftools,\
  \ and\nreturn the result as a bgzipped, tabixed VCF. Note that the nextflow.config\n\
  shipped with this subworkflow must be included for it to work properly.\n"
keywords:
- "filter"
- "vcf"
- "structural variants"
- "survivor"
- "bcftools"
components:
- "survivor/filter"
- "bcftools/filter"
- "htslib/bgziptabix"
input:
- ch_vcf:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing the VCF files to filter and, optionally,\n\
      BED files with regions to ignore (pattern: \"*.bed\"). Pass an empty list\n\
      for the BED file to filter genome-wide.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(vcf),\
      \ path(bed) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{vcf,vcf.gz}"
- minsv:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Min SV size passed to SURVIVOR filter (-1 to disable), ignored if\
      \ \"survivor\" is not in val_tools_to_use"
- maxsv:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Max SV size passed to SURVIVOR filter (-1 to disable), ignored if\
      \ \"survivor\" is not in val_tools_to_use"
- minallelefreq:
    type: "float"
    description: "Min allele frequency passed to SURVIVOR filter (0-1), ignored if\
      \ \"survivor\" is not in val_tools_to_use"
- minnumreads:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Min number of reads supporting the SV passed to SURVIVOR filter\
      \ (-1 to disable), ignored if \"survivor\" is not in val_tools_to_use"
- val_tools_to_use:
    type: "list"
    description: "The filtering tools to run, one or more of: '[\"survivor\", \"bcftools\"\
      ]'.\nSURVIVOR filters on size, allele frequency, read support and regions to\n\
      ignore; bcftools filter applies expressions passed to its ext.args.\n"
output:
- vcf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the filtered VCF files\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(vcf.gz) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.vcf.gz"
- tbi:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the indices of the filtered VCF files\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(tbi) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tbi"
- vcf_tbi:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing the filtered VCF files and their indices\n\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(vcf.gz), path(tbi) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{vcf.gz,tbi}"
authors:
- "@siddharthjayaraman"
maintainers:
- "@siddharthjayaraman"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bcftools/filter@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/htslib/bgziptabix@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/survivor/filter@0.0.0-6d1763b"
